Visualize a fitted bipartite stochastic block model

plot_bipartite.Rd

Produces base-R visualizations of fitted bipartite stochastic block models: block-reordered incidence matrices, mesoscale block-interaction diagrams, and two-column bipartite network layouts.

Usage

plot_bipartite(state, type = c("matrix", "meso", "network"), level = 1L,
  weight = NULL, main = NULL, palette = NULL, block_border = "#222222", ...)

Arguments

state

An rgraphtool_bipartite_block_state or rgraphtool_nested_bipartite_block_state.

type

Visualization type: "matrix" (block-reordered incidence or weight heatmap with block boundaries), "meso" (two-column mesoscale block interaction diagram), or "network" (two-column bipartite node-link diagram colored by inferred block).

level

Hierarchy level (1-based) for nested bipartite states.

weight

Optional edge property name to plot in type = "matrix".

main

Optional plot title.

palette

Optional color vector for type = "matrix".

block_border

Border color for block separators in type = "matrix".

...

Additional graphical arguments passed to the underlying base-R plotting function.

Value

Invisibly returns the plotted summary data (the reordered matrix and orders for "matrix", the density/count matrices for "meso", or the 2D vertex coordinates for "network").

Examples

set.seed(1)
M <- matrix(0L, 10, 10)
M[1:5, 1:5] <- rbinom(25, 1, 0.8)
M[6:10, 6:10] <- rbinom(25, 1, 0.8)
fit <- minimize_bipartite_blockmodel_dl(M, dim_labels = c("host", "parasite"))
plot_bipartite(fit, type = "matrix")

plot_bipartite(fit, type = "meso")
